info.title: MiniMax H3 Local API
info.summary: Local video generation and image/video upscaling on one GPU queue.
info.description:
Generate audio-video clips with MiniMax H3 and upscale uploaded images or whole videos with SeedVR2. Generation and upscale tasks share one GPU queue.

## Typical workflow
1. Upload required source media with `POST /v1/files`.
2. Submit `POST /v1/generations`, `POST /v1/edits` or `POST /v1/upscales`.
3. Poll `GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}` or consume its SSE event stream.
4. Download successful outputs from `outputs[].download_url`.

Authentication is only enforced when `H3_API_KEY` is configured. Supply it through `X-API-Key` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

get.description: Returns without loading or inspecting model resources.

Reports installed runtimes, weights, CUDA state, and whether H3/SeedVR2 resources are currently resident. Use capability=video before video generation to check only H3 dependencies without waiting for optional speech/music probes. Returns 503 when required assets are missing.

post.description: Uses the shared GPU queue. Returns a silent grayscale MP4 (near is bright), globally normalized across the clip, plus optional float32 NPZ. Preserves frame count and nominal FPS; variable-rate inputs become constant-rate. Poll /v1/tasks/{id} for downloads.

post.summary: Generate instrumental music or a song with YuE2
post.description: Returns a task ID for the shared GPU queue. Poll /v1/tasks/{id} for progress and download 48 kHz stereo PCM WAV, generation metadata JSON and an ABC score when planned. duration_seconds is a 10–500 second upper bound and can truncate a phrase; inspect metadata.truncated. Empty lyrics request instrumental music. cot controls symbolic planning. Running tasks can be canceled when H3_ALLOW_INTERRUPT_RUNNING=true.

post.summary: Separate a video foreground or repair its background
post.description: Select up to 8 objects with normalized boxes and reference frame indices. Each object is transparent before its reference frame. Exports separate foregrounds and repairs the union mask once. Legacy first-frame box requests remain supported. One request uses one task in the shared GPU queue.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Optional output short-edge preset. Explicit width/height take priority; if neither dimensions nor resolution is supplied, generation uses 1344x768 and editing uses source video dimensions. High presets are scaled down to the model pixel limit.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Width:height ratio used with resolution. Ignored when explicit dimensions are supplied or resolution is omitted.

width.title: Width
width.description: Output width; must be a multiple of 32. Explicit dimensions override resolution/aspect_ratio. Default 1344 when no preset is supplied.

height.title: Height
height.description: Output height; must be a multiple of 32. Explicit dimensions override resolution/aspect_ratio. Default 768 when no preset is supplied.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Optional deterministic seed. A random seed is used when omitted.
